calculation.description: For each completed trading day, rank assets by the negative of their prior-day return relative to the contemporaneous universe median. Cross-sectional clipping limits the effect of extreme observations. The signal is aligned at date t using data through t and predicts returns from t+1 onward.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.079669), 2023-2024 (+0.062972), and 2025-2027 (+0.029345), with expected attenuation in the latest regime. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.coverage_definition: mean valid signal fraction across the 15 tradable benchmark instruments
